content: We need to determine number of aromatic carbon atoms in the compound. But we have no description of the compound. Possibly the system expects us to retrieve NMR spectra and infer aromatic carbons? But we need the compound identity. Maybe the sample is implicit: we have to use carbon_nmr_spectra to get 13C NMR, then count aromatic carbon signals. However we don't know the compound; the tool will give spectra for "sample at hand". Likely the environment has a hidden sample. So we should call carbon_nmr_spectra to get 13C NMR data. Then count aromatic carbon signals. Aromatic carbons appear around 110-160 ppm. The tool returns a string with peaks. We need to parse. Let's call carbon_nmr_spectra.
